lanes.summary: The diff fully satisfies ticket PMAT-1365 without weakening any gate or violating repository invariants. It implements `make gate` via `scripts/gate.sh`, dynamically runs workflow steps directly from CI definitions, reports all unmeasured CI-only rows on both green and red exits, validates falsification behavior across 11 arms in `scripts/gate-control.sh`, and enforces contract invariants under `cargo test --lib make_gate_tests`. No refuting evidence was found.

findings.claim: Makefile declares a .PHONY `gate:` target running `scripts/gate.sh`, eliminating discovery fallback to `cargo test --workspace`.
`scripts/gate.sh` accounts for all 6 required CI status contexts, rejecting unaccounted contexts, reasonless CI-only rows, or vacuous tables with exit code 2.
`scripts/gate.sh` extracts workflow `run:` step scripts dynamically at runtime using Python/PyYAML, preventing drift between CI and local gate legs.
`scripts/gate-control.sh` executes 11 falsification arms asserting failure behavior on broken, malformed, or missing checks and tables.
`cargo test --lib make_gate_tests` passes 5 tests independently validating the declared Makefile target, workflow step parsing, context coverage, and prohibiting invalid CI-only exemptions.
